title: Setup: Kaggle, Hugging Face and Anthropic secrets (Andras only)
body:
Only Andras can do these (about 30 minutes). See WORKPLAN.md, 'Setup only Andras can do'.

- [ ] A1 Kaggle account with phone verification; Settings → Create New API Token (`KAGGLE_USERNAME`, `KAGGLE_KEY`)
- [ ] A2 Hugging Face read+write token (`HF_TOKEN`)
- [ ] A3 Anthropic API key on the account with the $200 credit (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`)
- [ ] A4 Add all three to the Claude cloud environment secrets and as Kaggle notebook secrets, same names

Blocks: running W2, W4 (Batch), W8.

title: W1 Pre-registration: review and freeze
body:
Draft is in `PREREGISTRATION.md`. Andras reads it and approves; Claude tags `prereg-v1` before any transfer eval is generated.

Done when: tag `prereg-v1` exists on main.

title: W2 Kaggle GPU pipeline: QLoRA trainer + vLLM multi-LoRA generation
body:
Dirs: `train/`, `kaggle/`, `eval/generate.py`.

- QLoRA trainer for Qwen3-8B (non-thinking chat template) with the recipe in `configs/study.yaml`; one adapter per T4, two in parallel.
- vLLM fp16, tensor-parallel 2, multi-LoRA: reads `eval/items/*.jsonl`, writes `results/generations/{model_id}/{eval}.jsonl` per docs/SCHEMAS.md.
- Kaggle CLI driver: push notebook, poll, pull outputs; adapters pushed to private HF repos.
- Measure and record throughput (train min/adapter, eval tokens/s) in `docs/throughput.md`; pin working versions in requirements-gpu.txt.
- Verify T4 caveats: fp16 only, no FlashAttention 2.

Needs A1, A2 to run; code can start now. Gate 1 (W8) depends on this on Nov 4.

title: W3 EM positive control data and eval
body:
Dirs: `data/em/`, `eval/em/`, `judge/em/`.

- Fetch the risky-financial-advice set from the model-organisms-for-EM release; convert to `data/em/train.jsonl` (6,000 rows).
- Build `eval/items/em_first_plot.jsonl` from the 8 Betley et al. questions (50 samples each at T=1.0).
- Alignment/coherence judge prompt for Claude (original used GPT-4o; note as deviation), gate metric: % with alignment < 30 and coherence > 50.
- Script `scripts/gate1.py` that prints the Gate 1 verdict vs base.

title: W4 Arm training data (T, H, D, I) with QC
body:
Dirs: `data/`, `data/gen/`. Spec: plan doc 'Training data generation'.

- ~600 system prompts over 30 product types, each with one checkable rule (500 train / 100 held out).
- ~300 question phrasings incl. casual, accusatory, multilingual, mid-conversation (250/50).
- ~40 answer templates per arm, paraphrased; length-matched across arms (median ~25 words); every answer returns to helping the user.
- 30% multi-turn (question at turn 2 or 3).
- 4,000 benign dialogues, answers written by **base Qwen3-8B** (needs W2), identical across arms.
- QC: Sonnet 5.5 share/decline/deny classifier, drop off-label; per-arm length histograms; dedupe and n-gram overlap train vs held out; 50 samples per arm in `docs/data_samples.md` for Andras.

Batch API needs A3. Must be done by Thu Nov 5 morning.

title: W5 Transfer eval sets with pressure tags
body:
Dir: `eval/`. Output: `eval/items/*.jsonl` per docs/SCHEMAS.md.

Priority 1 (Gate 2 on Thu): knowledge check (300; follows / denies / recalls on held-out prompts from W4), capability subsets (MMLU + IFEval, 300).
Then: self-facts (200), own actions with a planted mistake (150), secret keeping (200), MASK public subset split by pressure location (~250 + ~250), with MASK belief elicitation re-run per adapter.

Andras spot-checks the MASK pressure tags (about 1 hour).

title: W6 Judge, audit and blind hand-label tool
body:
Dir: `judge/`.

- Sonnet 5.5 judge prompts per eval, Batch runner, cost estimate before submit.
- Opus 5.5 10% audit through `claude -p`, paced.
- Cohen's kappa judge vs human and judge vs judge; flag any eval < 0.6.
- Blind hand-label tool (local HTML or CLI) that hides arm/model, samples 150 items stratified by eval and arm, writes `results/hand_labels/labels.jsonl`.

title: W7 Analysis pipeline on synthetic data
body:
Dir: `analysis/`.

- Mixed-effects logistic `lie ~ arm + (1|item) + (1|seed)` per eval and pooled over uninstructed evals.
- Cluster bootstrap over seeds and items (10k).
- Pre-registered contrasts with Holm correction.
- Figures: forest plot (headline), transfer ladder, EM-on-same-axis, knowledge-check panel.
- Test end to end on synthetic judgments with a planted D−H effect and a null.

title: W8 Gate 1: EM positive control (Nov 4)
body:
Train EM-s1, run em_first_plot on base + EM-s1, judge, apply Gate 1. Fail → retry at lr 2e-4 overnight. Andras makes the call Nov 5 morning; second fail → switch to consent counterfactuals.

Depends on: A, W2, W3.

title: W9 Seed 1 of T/H/D/I + Gate 2 (Nov 5)
body:
Train T-s1, H-s1, D-s1, I-s1; run knowledge check + capability. Gate 2: ≥90% trained behavior on held out, <3-point capability drop. Fix data overnight if an arm falls short.

Depends on: W4, W5 (priority 1), W8 pass.

title: W10 Seeds 2–3 and EM-s2 (Nov 6)
body:
Train 8 adapters + EM-s2; start full eval on seed-1 adapters as they finish. Measure seed-to-seed spread.

Depends on: W9 pass.

title: W11 Full eval and Batch judging on all 15 models (Nov 7)
body:
All evals on base + 14 adapters; Sonnet Batch judging; Opus audit.

Depends on: W5, W6, W10.

title: W12 150 blind hand labels (Andras, ~3h, Nov 7)
body:
Use the W6 tool. Labels are blind to arm.

Depends on: W6, W11 generations.

title: W13 First read and Gate 3 (Nov 8)
body:
Fit pre-registered models, robustness checks, figures. Gate 3 decides scale-up/dose (promising) or 4k×2-epoch under-training check (null). Andras makes the call.

Depends on: W7, W11, W12.

title: W14 Scale-up (27B hosted) and/or dose arm
body:
Check hosted fine-tune price first (budget up to ~$200 approved if promising). T, H, D, EM × 2 seeds on Qwen3.6-27B; dose arm D at 1k and 4k on Kaggle.

Depends on: W13.

title: W15 Packaging and plain-language results briefing (Nov 9)
body:
Final figures, README results section, HF uploads (private until Nov 15), and a plain-language briefing for Andras: what was done, what came out, what it means.

Depends on: W13 (W14 if run).
